text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
So marvelous! ☆ Care for something

marvelous? ★

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Care for something marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer! How marvelous! ☆ Care for

something absolutely marvelous? ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, after running into Marvelous
Sunday
and Ikuno Dictus, I find myself
being greeted in a
bizarre manner.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! ☆ We're handing out the

marvelousness that everyone loves! Care
for
something marvelous? ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's almost like she's reenacting The Little Match Girl...

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Marvelous invited me to help out.

Distributing wonder and happiness
around the
academy is a commendable
notion, so I decided
to join in.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahh, marvelous! ☆ Ikuno is the greatest
advocate
of all things marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hey! What are you doing over there?!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
There have been reports of strange
students
wandering around saying odd
things! Stop this
absurdity at once!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: But Teacher! It's Marvelous! Marvelous, I say! ☆ This world needs marvelousness. ★

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Wh-what on earth are you talking
about?! Just
cease this dubious behavior!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Forgive my impertinence, but there's
nothing
dubious about what we're doing.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
This is an altruistic service. Marvelous is

attempting to use wonder itself as a
means to
deliver happiness, excitement,
and joy to all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There is nothing wrong about that, and I
deem
her conduct virtuous.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Still... are you sure you're not
scheming
anything devious?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous does not harbor any ulterior
motives.
She has a genuine desire to
share things she
believes are wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
No scheming is underway here. The
proof lies in
the fact that she doesn't
seek any compensation
for her efforts.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: Hmph...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: A splendid explanation, Ikuno! You are indeed marvelous! ☆ Supremely marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you raise a valid point! ☆ It looks
like it's
time to get marvelous! ★ Trainer,
what manner of
marvelous thing do you
desire?
choice_data_list: マーベラスをもらうとどうなるんだ？
マーベラスをもらうとどうなるの？

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Wow! ☆ You seem very earnest about
this! Okay,
here we go! Some marvelous
comfort is coming
your way! ★
choice_data_list: 最近カロリーが気になってて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon saying this, Marvelous Sunday
lights a
single match.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: What the?! What's happening?!

text_block_list.name: Dog
text_block_list.text: Woof, woof!

text_block_list.name: Cat
text_block_list.text: Meow.

text_block_list.name: Sheep
text_block_list.text: Baaaa.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Oho, they are indeed very fluffy. Hehe,
here
doggy, here kitty.
choice_data_list: モ……モフモフがいっぱい！？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus has already adapted to the

situation.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Goodness! They're so fluffy! Being
around all
these furry creatures is sooo
soothing!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ahh! ☆ I know just what you mean!
Okay, here we
go! A marvelously full
stomach is coming your
way! ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Upon saying this, Marvelous Sunday
lights a
single match.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: What the?! What's happening?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A lavish banquet is laid out before our
eyes.
Turkey, carrot hamburger steaks,
gratin, cake—it
all looks delicious.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My, what a splendid feast. It smells
scrumptious
and the flavors are
exquisite. My mouth is in total
bliss.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... The dessert is delectable, too. I
would
very much like for McQueen to
taste it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno Dictus has already adapted to the

situation.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
D-delicious! Everything here is simply
amazing!
Can we really eat all this
without worrying about
the calories?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
How was it? ☆ Did you enjoy my
marvelous Little
Match Girl
experience? ★
choice_data_list: 美味しい……！美味しいよぉっ！

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: It was... marvelous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Haha! ☆ Wonderful! I'm glad that you've
all come
to realize why marvelous things
are so, well...
marvelous! ★
choice_data_list: マーベラス最高おおおぉぉぉっ！

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: I believe the matter is settled, then.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Wooooow! ☆ All that is marvelous is
wondrous! ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I get the sense I may have gotten
involved in
something I shouldn't
have—something way out
there—but it
certainly was a fulfilling day.
